decisions: Enable the current Chrome Root Store and builtin verifier on OHOS
Use OHOS TrustStoreOhos only for user-added local trust settings alongside current Google public roots
Wire the native adapter dependency so native certificate headers get AKI includes
Map native self-signed leaf errors to current CERT_STATUS_AUTHORITY_INVALID
Do not reuse old status bits that collide with current certificate statuses
Do not wire the legacy M132 certificate verifier as the main OHOS verifier
Use current TrustStoreInMemory normalized issuer matching instead of raw DER name comparison
Preserve OHOS private-certificate leaf-only and enterprise certificate anchor trust; do not add system public roots to the local trust provider
Keep certificate URI when cloning intermediates; own BoringSSL URI extension data until X509 destruction
Advertise only the signing scheme implemented by the current HAP bridge; reject empty signatures and oversize output
